slides.h1: How to pick your first marketing channel.
slides.lead: Not ten channels. One, done properly.
Physically or online. If your users live in one place, that place is a channel.
With your time and budget. Not the one that worked for a big company.

slides.h2: If you can't measure it, you can't learn.
slides.lead: Separate links, QR codes or campaigns, so you know what brought each install.
A few buildings. A small ad budget. Learn before you scale.
Decide what "working" means, then give it enough time to find out.

points: Offline: flyers with QR codes in towers, via a distribution vendor
